sources.title: Meet PosterSentry: Guarding the Gate to FAIR Poster Data
sources.snippet: Posters.science exists to change that. Supported by a grant from The Navigation Fund, it is a platform that makes the knowledge inside posters FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) and ready for AI. It works in two ways. It gives researchers a simple place to share their own posters, and it gathers posters that already live in other repositories, such as Zenodo and Figshare ...
